listing.name: Tales of the Faithful
listing.summary: BEHOLD! The Prayer-class Mobile Chapel! Depending on your captain's faith, it provides your fleet a bonus to Combat Readiness. There's a minimum of 2% to represent the Faithful in your fleet, regardless of the captain's belief, making it possibly worthwhile to keep around even only for your crew.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a Prayer-class Mobile Chapel ship that boosts fleet Combat Readiness based on captain faith.

description:
Tales of the Faithful

Are you a Luddic? Do you feel as though the faith is underrepresented outside of the major quests? Do you want some minor flavor to accent your devout fleet? Well, I don't have the mod for you (yet) but I have the next best thing!

BEHOLD! The Prayer-class Mobile Chapel! Depending on your captain's faith, it provides your fleet a bonus to Combat Readiness. There's a minimum of 2% to represent the Faithful in your fleet, regardless of the captain's belief, making it possibly worthwhile to keep around even only for your crew.

The Overgrown Habitat event is expanded! It is still a WIP, but after you discover the station and choose not to disturb it, in a month's time, it will be inhabited by new attendants dedicated to preserving it. More to come!

Download here :3

I've set up a server to discuss my mod(s) :3

Thanks to the developers, especially David for all his work on the Luddic faith which inspired me so, the Unofficial Starsector Chat for their help in coding, to you for playing with my little funny mods,
and special thanks to Reeves, AstraAegis, Vemauv, 7556, Jal, Jaydee, and Vexlia, without whom the mod would not exist or function, and this entire idea would still be sitting in my head.
